appointments_notes_length.name: appointments_notes_length
appointments_notes_length.value: "appointments"."notes" is null or char_length("appointments"."notes") between 1 and 1000

appointments_recurrence_until.name: appointments_recurrence_until
appointments_recurrence_until.value: ("appointments"."recurrence" = 'weekly' or "appointments"."recurrence_until" is null) and ("appointments"."recurrence_until" is null or "appointments"."recurrence_until" >= "appointments"."starts_on")

invitations_student_target_check.name: invitations_student_target_check
invitations_student_target_check.value: ("invitations"."environment" = 'student' and "invitations"."student_id" is not null and "invitations"."target_kind" is not null and (("invitations"."target_kind" = 'student' and "invitations"."guardian_id" is null) or ("invitations"."target_kind" = 'guardian' and "invitations"."guardian_id" is not null))) or ("invitations"."environment" <> 'student' and "invitations"."student_id" is null and "invitations"."guardian_id" is null and "invitations"."target_kind" is null)

task_occurrences_notes_length.name: task_occurrences_notes_length
task_occurrences_notes_length.value: "task_occurrences"."notes" is null or char_length("task_occurrences"."notes") between 1 and 1000

task_occurrences_exception.name: task_occurrences_exception
task_occurrences_exception.value: ("task_occurrences"."exception_kind" = 'moved' and "task_occurrences"."moved_date" is not null and (("task_occurrences"."moved_time_kind" = 'all-day' and "task_occurrences"."moved_starts_at" is null and "task_occurrences"."moved_ends_at" is null) or ("task_occurrences"."moved_time_kind" = 'timed' and "task_occurrences"."moved_starts_at" is not null and "task_occurrences"."moved_ends_at" is not null and "task_occurrences"."moved_ends_at" > "task_occurrences"."moved_starts_at"))) or ("task_occurrences"."exception_kind" <> 'moved' and "task_occurrences"."moved_date" is null and "task_occurrences"."moved_time_kind" is null and "task_occurrences"."moved_starts_at" is null and "task_occurrences"."moved_ends_at" is null)

tasks_notes_length.name: tasks_notes_length
tasks_notes_length.value: "tasks"."notes" is null or char_length("tasks"."notes") between 1 and 500

tasks_time.name: tasks_time
tasks_time.value: ("tasks"."time_kind" = 'all-day' and "tasks"."starts_at" is null and "tasks"."ends_at" is null) or ("tasks"."time_kind" = 'timed' and "tasks"."starts_at" is not null and "tasks"."ends_at" is not null and "tasks"."ends_at" > "tasks"."starts_at")

tasks_recurrence.name: tasks_recurrence
tasks_recurrence.value: ("tasks"."recurrence_kind" = 'none' and "tasks"."recurrence_weekdays" is null and "tasks"."recurrence_until" is null) or ("tasks"."recurrence_kind" = 'daily' and "tasks"."recurrence_weekdays" is null) or ("tasks"."recurrence_kind" = 'weekly' and cardinality("tasks"."recurrence_weekdays") between 1 and 7 and "tasks"."recurrence_weekdays" <@ '{1,2,3,4,5,6,7}'::smallint[] and extract(isodow from "tasks"."starts_on")::smallint = any("tasks"."recurrence_weekdays"))
